THE LEARNING EXPERIENCE

Confidence grows through practice.

Clinical learning needs more than theory. EPRium brings simulated patient encounters and an electronic patient record together so learners can practise taking histories, reviewing information, documenting care and making decisions in context.

Educators can use realistic scenarios to guide discussion, repetition and reflection across disciplines.

WHAT LEARNERS CAN DO

From patient conversation to clinical record.

One connected journey helps learners practise how care is delivered and documented.

01 / ENCOUNTER

Meet virtual patients

Ask questions, take a history and understand the person behind the presentation.

02 / INVESTIGATE

Review clinical information

Work through observations, patient history and the information relevant to the scenario.

03 / DECIDE

Make informed choices

Assess the situation, consider next steps and practise clinical reasoning safely.

04 / DOCUMENT

Use a simulated EPR

Record assessments and care decisions in a familiar digital workflow.

FOR EDUCATORS AND PROGRAMMES

Make practice part of the programme.

Give students opportunities to repeat clinical encounters, prepare for placements and discuss decisions with educators. Scenarios can support classroom teaching, independent practice and facilitated sessions.
